Short title and commencement

HEAVY INDUSTRIES BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
HEAVY INDUSTRIES
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 8th September, 2000]
No. F.2(1)/2000-Pub. dated
8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Heavy Industries Board
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of long title and preamble, Act XII of 1997

HEAVY INDUSTRIES BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
HEAVY INDUSTRIES
BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE XLVII OF
2000
An Ordinance to
amend the Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997
[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 8th September, 2000]
No. F.2(1)/2000-Pub. dated
8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
2. Amendment of long title and
preamble, Act XII of 1997.--In the Heavy Industries Board Act, 1997 (XII of
1997), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in the long title and preamble
for the words "Board Taxila" the words "Taxila Board" shall
be substituted.

Amendment of section 1, Act XII of 1997

8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
3. Amendment of section 1, Act
XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 1, in subsection (1), after the
word "Industries" the word "Taxila" shall be inserted.

Amendment of section 2, Act XII of 1997

8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
4. Amendment of section 2, Act
XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 2,--
(a) in
clause,(a), after the word "Industries" the word "Taxila"
shall be inserted; and
(b) in clause
(c), after the word "Industries" the word "Taxila" shall be
inserted.

Amendment of section 3, Act XII of 1997

HEAVY INDUSTRIES BOARD (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000

[Gazette of
Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 8th September, 2000]
No. F.2(1)/2000-Pub. dated
8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
5. Amendment of section 3, Act
XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 3,--
(a) in
subsection (1),--
(i) after the
word "Industries" the word "Taxila" shall be inserted; and
(ii) for the
word "six" the word "five" shall be substituted; and
(b) in
subsection (3),--
(i) for the word
"six" the word "five" shall be substituted; and
(ii) for the
words "third and fourth being sitting members of the National Assembly of
Pakistan as Coordinators" the words, commas and brackets "third
member shall be appointed from the corporate sector, to be called the member
(private), on the recommendation of the Secretary, Defence Production
Division" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 4, Act XII of 1997

[Gazette of

No. F.2(1)/2000-Pub. dated
8-9-2000.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information.
6. Amendment of section 4, Act
XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 4,--
(a) in
subsection (1), for the full stop at the end, a colon shall be substituted and
thereafter the following new proviso shall be added namely:--
"Provided that the Member
(Private) shall hold office in honorary capacity";
(b) in
subsection (2), after the word "Co-ordination" the words and brackets
"and Member (Private)" shall be inserted; and
(c) in
subsection (3), after the word "member" the commas, words and
brackets", except Member (Private)," shall be inserted.

Amendment of section 6, Act XII of 1997

7. Amendment of section 6,
Act, XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 6, in subsection (1), after
the word "manage" the commas and words "organise or as the case
may be, within the existing financial resources, reorganise any factory"
shall be inserted.

Amendment of section 11, Act XII of 1997

8. Amendment of section 11,
Act XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 11,--
(a) after the
word "authorize" the words and comma "the Chairman, shall be
inserted;
(b) after the
word "members" the words "or any subordinate authority of Heavy
Industries" shall be inserted; and
(c) for the word "member" the words and comma
"Chairman, member or the subordinate authority" shall be substituted.
